title: High BMI in children and adolescents 6 years or older: provide or refer to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians provide or refer children and adolescents 6 years or older with a high body mass index (BMI) (≥95th percentile for age and sex) to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions.

action: Provide or refer children and adolescents 6 years or older with BMI at or above the 95th percentile for age and sex to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions.

all.note: BMI percentile for age and sex, not raw BMI

derived.window: text states no lookback period; latest measurement-year BMI percentile assumed

numerator.note: Either provision of or referral to the intervention counts ('provide or refer')

derived.window: text states no timeframe for providing or referring; measurement year assumed
